pretreatments.description: Mechanical disintegration: The wastewater sludge was subjected to ultrasonication using a Bandelin-Sonopuls HD 3400 ultrasonic homogeniser at 20 kHz, 70% amplitude, and 200 W power. The treatment was performed for 15 and 30 minutes to achieve specific energies of 15,000 and 25,000 kJ/kg TS, respectively. This process was intended to disrupt the cell structure and enhance solubility of sludge solids.

Thermal disintegration: Wastewater sludge samples underwent thermal treatment using a Microwave Digestion Unit (Berghoff Speedwave MWS-3+). The treatment applied a staged temperature profile, with microwave pre-treatment conducted at 175 °C and 2000 kPa for 30 minutes. This method aims to improve the biodegradability by breaking down sludge particles.
